name: Twin Pump
summary: Skid- and trailer-mounted twin pumping unit with dual triplex and centrifugal pumps plus onboard data acquisition.
specs: Deck engines: 2× Detroit Diesel 8V-71, 305 bhp; transmission: Allison CLBT-754
Control panel with data acquisition & recording
Triplex pumps: 2× Gardner Denver PG (3.75" @ 10,000 psi and 4.5" @ 5,000 psi)
Includes hydraulic, diesel and air tanks with high/low-pressure piping
imageAlt: MBF twin pump skid and trailer unit
